artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two travelers with animals in a forest setting. The drawing captures a detailed scene within a circle. Two figures in medieval or rustic clothing are shown on a journey. One figure is walking, while the other rides a donkey. They are accompanied by oxen. The forest background is filled with detailed trees and foliage, creating a sense of movement and life. The drawing is realistic and has a historic character.

artworks.title: Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring several figures in an architectural setting. The image includes four figures positioned in front of a structure resembling a small temple or monument with columns and a frieze. The figure on the left wears armor and holds a circular object. The central figure, also in armor, is semi-seated with head bowed. Two nude figures on the right are depicted, one tying a rope around the central figure while the other observes. The background shows dense foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting. The scene conveys a narrative quality with dynamic interaction among the figures. The drawing is done in a classical or renaissance style similar to engravings by artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.6 x 23.5 cm (10 7/8 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with a small house and surrounding landscape. The drawing shows a woman in flowing robes sitting outside a wooden structure, accompanied by a small figure. An older figure stands to the right with a staff. In the sky, two cherubic figures are among the clouds. The background includes rocky hills, a winding path, groups of animals, and trees. The drawing is detailed with textural shading and contrast between light and dark, emphasizing the scene's tranquility and beauty.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing the Lion
artworks.description: The image shows a man grappling with a lion. The man is muscular and bearded, while the lion appears fierce. Strong lines and detailing are used to emphasize the figures. The background includes a tree and foliage.

artworks.title: Mutius Scaevola
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a knight and two men inside a tent. The knight wears armor and a plumed helmet, facing two seated men under a richly decorated tent. One man, with a long beard, holds a dagger above a table. A sword is placed centrally, gripped by all figures. In the background, spears with banners stand upright. The drawing is detailed, with textures applied to the folds of clothing, armor, and tent canopy.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative and mythological scene. The design includes a central image of a mythical creature with a humanoid figure riding it in the ocean. Surrounding the central scene are decorative elements such as birds, vines, floral motifs, and shell-like structures. The overall composition is highly stylized with a Baroque or Rococo influence, characterized by elaborate forms. The top center shows a mythical figure playing a wind instrument amongst foliage. The artwork displays symmetry and detailed line work typical of historical decorative arts focusing on ornamentation.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and symmetrical shapes circling around a central diamond shape with a depiction of a horseman. Scroll-like tendrils, floral motifs, and crescent shapes are interwoven in the abstract composition. Figures resembling crouching primates are at the top corners, and elements resembling arranged weapons or heraldic symbols are at the lower corners. Organic and geometric forms combine to create a rich tapestry of interconnectivity and complexity.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and ornamental shapes arranged in a symmetric pattern. In the center, there are two horned figures resembling satyrs with outstretched arms. A scene in an oval frame shows smaller figures carrying circular objects with a cloud above them. The decoration includes ornamental flourishes and detailed motifs.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized artwork focusing on a central composition with a stag in a landscape. Surrounding the stag are intricate flora and fauna elements creating a symmetrical pattern. In the background, there are buildings near a curved horizon. The sky has stylized clouds, and soft lines form the horizon. The ornate pattern extends to winged insects, birds on scrolls, and floral motifs. The color scheme is primarily black ink on a beige background, giving an antique look to the artwork.

artworks.title: Ornament with Grotesque
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intricate decorative motifs with mythical creatures and floral designs. The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement with an oval shape in the center, containing letters "CR" above "F.A." and the date "1616" underneath. Surrounding the central medallion are elegant, swirling floral designs and fantastical creatures reminiscent of satyrs, adorned with leaves and flowers. Above the central oval is a drum with arms and flags protruding, while in the corners, there are two birds in motion. Below the medallion is a skull design, adding a macabre element to the composition, which is balanced by the ornamental extravagance of the whole artwork.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays intricate, symmetrical patterns composed of curving lines and swirls forming an abstract design. The central shape resembles a stylized, ornate butterfly or mask, with smaller similarly styled shapes above and below. These abstract designs have sharp points and flowing curls, reminiscent of calligraphy or decorative woodwork. The composition is set against a textured background, providing depth and an antique feel.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image features a central diamond shape filled with black intricate designs consisting of curved lines and symmetrical patterns, surrounded by abstract ornate motifs. The composition includes elements resembling medieval shields or ornate masks with pointed tops and floral-like details. The arrangement and decorative embellishments around the edges evoke the look of vintage playing cards or coat of arms, imparting a sense of heraldry and craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays a design with symmetrical black shapes and lines on a textured beige background. The central motif resembles an abstract bird or bat with swirling patterns. Above it is a smaller shape with tendrils and dot embellishments. Below, there are two rectangles with intricate patterns suggestive of floral prints. The letters "S", "A", and "D" are positioned with elegant curves, creating a decorative and nature-inspired composition.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays an arrangement of curving lines and geometric shapes forming an oval design in the center, framed by symmetrical embellishments on each side and corner. The composition resembles ornate floral patterns with elements resembling curling vines and stylized blossoms. The decoration includes small circles and dots, creating a complex and visually engaging texture similar to lacework or wrought iron craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ornament
artworks.description: The image features a large diamond shape with swirling lines and floral patterns. Surrounding the diamond are smaller triangles and columns with similar ornate designs. The design includes letters and numbers, resembling a blueprint or work in progress. The composition resembles a textile design or wallpaper with symmetrical motifs.

artworks.title: Scourging of Christ
artworks.description: This is a painting of a biblical scene depicting an individual being scourged. In the piece, an individual stands tied to a pillar, their body covered with marks and wounds. Two other individuals surround them, each wielding an instrument suggesting an act of flagellation. The scene is set against a textured background with earthy tones and a green foreground. The figures are depicted in a stylized manner typical of older religious artwork, with pronounced expressions and exaggerated forms. The image uses a palette of muted colors and is reminiscent of medieval religious art.

artworks.title: Martyr with an Angel
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown-gray wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of two figures. The person on the right is seated and facing slightly towards the left, with their head tilted downwards as if looking at the other figure. This person has curly hair styled into an updo or braided at the back, and wears a long, flowing garment with intricate drapery and folds. A circular ornament is depicted on the chest, and a halo surrounds the head. The seated person holds a staff in their left hand. To the person's right stands a cherubic figure with small, feathered wings, holding a bowl filled with circular objects, possibly fruit. This smaller figure has curly hair and appears to be looking up toward the seated person. The background is plain and textured, with faint sketching to suggest fabric or clouds swirling around.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Kings [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a historical and possibly biblical setting. The image shows several figures, some wearing crowns and robes. At the center is a seated figure holding a child, surrounded by other figures in a gesture of homage or offering. The figures are intricately dressed with detailed clothing and accessories. The background features architectural elements like columns and steps. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of grey with a technique emphasizing contrasts and light. The style shows influences from Renaissance artwork, focusing on detail and depth.

artworks.title: The Birth of Christ [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brush and gray ink and  gray wash heightened with white on gray prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The scene depicts a stable setting with figures gathered around an infant lying in a manger. The figures are intricately detailed, with some holding shepherd's staffs and others with hands raised. A winged figure is seen above, likely symbolizing an angelic presence, casting a beam of light downwards. Animals like sheep and donkeys are present. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing shades of gray to emphasize texture and depth, with careful attention to the folds in garments and expressions of reverence in the figures' faces. The composition is rich with traditional religious symbolism.

artworks.title: Der Bärenzwinger im zoologischen Garten (The Bear Pit in the Zoological Gardens)
artworks.medium: lithograph on Chine appliqué on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five bears in an enclosed area. One bear is climbing a tree, while the others are on the ground, one standing on its hind legs. The background features a high wall with onlookers peering over the edge. The artist depicts the bears' interactions and detailed expressions, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: The Sudarium of Saint Veronica
artworks.description: This print shows a close-up view of a man's head, with no neck visible. The man is facing directly forward and looking out at us. He has light skin, a straight nose, a short beard and mustache, and slightly furrowed brows. His expression is neutral, and his face appears to be covered in small cuts or drops of blood. He has long, curling hair, and on top of his head is a circlet of thorny branches that cut into his scalp. Surrounding the head is a thin circle with some diagonal lines running through it, possibly representing a halo. Below the head are some words written faintly. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Collège Henri IV, Paris, ou Lycée Napoléon (Henry IV College or Napoleon School, Paris)
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial perspective of an urban scene with intricate details. The background is filled with buildings and hills, with a tower in the foreground and rows of buildings with pitched roofs in the distance. The style resembles a detailed etching with fine linework defining the structures and natural elements. The color palette is primarily shades of gray, enhancing the detailed linework. A mountain rises to the left, and boats are in the distance on water to the right.

artworks.title: Collège Henri IV, Paris, ou Lycée Napoléon (Henry IV College or Napoleon School, Paris)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 22 × 41.3 cm (8 11/16 × 16 1/4 in.)
plate (cut to platemark): 24.5 × 43 cm (9 5/8 × 16 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a historic urban landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third with distant buildings, hills, and ships. An architectural complex with detailed roofs and a central tower is in the foreground. The etching features fine, linear strokes for texture. The color palette is sepia, creating a historic atmosphere. The background shows a bustling cityscape with figures on the streets.
